scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, and value proposition prominently (REQ-1, REQ-2, US-1)

steps.description: Load the MirDB homepage in a browser
steps.context: User accesses the homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that the hero section is immediately visible above the fold
steps.context: Hero section should be the first thing users see

steps.description: Confirm 'MirDB' is prominently displayed in the hero section
steps.context: Product name should be in a heading element (h1)

steps.description: Check for a clear tagline explaining MirDB is a persistent key-value store with memcached compatibility
steps.context: Tagline should communicate core value proposition

steps.description: Check for primary call-to-action button (Get Started or View on GitHub)
steps.context: CTA should be visually prominent and clickable

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains h1 element with 'MirDB' text

test_cases.input: Check hero section for tagline element
test_cases.expected: Tagline mentions 'persistent key-value store' and 'memcached'

test_cases.input: Locate primary CTA button in hero section
test_cases.expected: CTA button exists with text 'Get Started' or 'View on GitHub' and has href attribute
Hero section uses semantic HTML with appropriate heading hierarchy

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section showcases key MirDB capabilities (REQ-3, US-2)

steps.description: Load the MirDB homepage
steps.context: User wants to learn about features

steps.description: Scroll down or navigate to the features section
steps.context: Features section should be below hero section

steps.description: Check that 3-4 feature cards are displayed
steps.context: Each feature should have its own card

steps.description: Confirm feature about memcached protocol support is present
steps.context: Should mention standard text protocol and client compatibility

steps.description: Confirm feature about data persistence (SSTables) is present
Confirm feature about LSM tree architecture is present

test_cases.input: Count feature card elements in features section
test_cases.expected: At least 3 feature cards are present

test_cases.input: Search features section for memcached-related content
test_cases.expected: Text mentioning 'memcached protocol' or 'memcached compatible' exists

test_cases.input: Search features section for persistence-related content
test_cases.expected: Text mentioning 'persistence' or 'SSTables' or 'durable' exists

test_cases.input: Search features section for LSM tree content
test_cases.expected: Text mentioning 'LSM' or 'Log-Structured Merge' exists

test_cases.input: Verify each feature card has title and description
test_cases.expected: Each feature card contains a heading and descriptive text

scenarios.name: Quick Start Section
scenarios.description: Verify quick start section provides installation and usage examples (REQ-4, REQ-5, US-3)

steps.description: Scroll to or click navigation to quick start section
steps.context: User wants to try MirDB quickly

steps.description: Check for installation/setup command or instructions
steps.context: Should show cargo install or similar

steps.description: Check for basic SET/GET usage examples
steps.context: Should show how to connect and perform basic operations

steps.description: Check that code blocks have syntax highlighting
steps.context: Code should be readable with proper formatting

test_cases.input: Locate quick start section and check for installation instructions
test_cases.expected: Section contains installation command (cargo install or similar)

test_cases.input: Check for code blocks with usage examples
test_cases.expected: At least one code block showing SET operation exists

test_cases.input: Check for code blocks with GET operation
test_cases.expected: At least one code block showing GET operation exists

test_cases.input: Verify code blocks have proper formatting
test_cases.expected: Code blocks use <pre><code> or equivalent with syntax highlighting classes

test_cases.input: Verify quick start section has link to full documentation
test_cases.expected: Link to documentation or 'learn more' exists in or near quick start section

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Mobile
scenarios.description: Verify homepage renders correctly on mobile devices (NFR-1, US-6)

steps.description: Set viewport to mobile size (375px width)
Check that content fits within viewport width
steps.context: Mobile users shouldn't need to scroll horizontally

steps.description: Check for hamburger menu or accessible navigation
Check font sizes are readable without zooming
steps.context: Content must be legible on small screens

steps.description: Check that buttons and links are easily tappable
steps.context: Touch targets should be at least 44x44px

test_cases.expected: No horizontal overflow, page width equals viewport width
Navigation is accessible via hamburger menu or visible links

test_cases.input: Check body font size at mobile viewport
test_cases.expected: Base font size is at least 16px

test_cases.input: Measure CTA button dimensions at mobile viewport
test_cases.expected: Button touch target is at least 44px in height
Meta viewport tag with width=device-width is present

scenarios.name: Page Performance

steps.description: Load page and measure time to interactive
Verify images are optimized and minimal JS used
Execute Lighthouse performance audit

Page fully loads within 3000ms on broadband

steps.context: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text

steps.description: Verify all interactive elements are keyboard accessible
Verify all images have appropriate alt text
Verify proper use of heading hierarchy and landmarks
Verify skip navigation link exists
steps.context: Allows screen reader users to skip to main content

test_cases.expected: No critical accessibility violations detected

test_cases.input: Check all img elements for alt attributes
test_cases.expected: All images have alt attributes (can be empty for decorative)
Page has single h1 and proper heading sequence without skipping levels
All interactive elements are reachable via Tab key with visible focus
Skip to main content link exists and is first focusable element
Page uses header, main, nav, and footer landmark elements
Text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for normal, 3:1 for large)
